notes.title: Routastic event is coming! 🔥
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! 👋

We're thrilled to announce that we're preparing a Routastic Event that will be [b]live on April 26th, 2023. [/b]The event will feature some huge discounts on our games. What is more, we'll be giving away some Steam keys to some of the games from our friendly developers, so make sure to mark those dates in calendars, folks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43913954/a0e6987ed31dda04ede74ec4a501166978e408b2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Road Diner Simulator – New Cinematic Teaser🍔[/h2]

We've been eagerly waiting to share this news with you, folks! We've managed to prepare a new cinematic teaser for Road Diner Simulator, and for those of you who have already played Gas Station Simulator, we guarantee you gonna see some familiar faces there! We cannot wait to share more information regarding Road Diner Simulator in the future. But enough talking – grab your favorite drink & snack, and simply enjoy watching the trailer below⬇️

[previewyoutube=mRYF3urUYcU;full][/previewyoutube]

Stay up-to-date📰

And we've come to an end, folks! We cannot wait to share more information regarding the event, Road Diner Simulator, and American Airport Simulator. While you eagerly waiting for all of this suff, you can check our other titles. For instance, Airstrip DLC is releasing just in two weeks, so if you don't want to miss it, consider adding it to your wishlist, so you'll be notified as soon as the game releases.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2137370/Gas_Station_Simulator__Airstrip_DLC/
